caption:
V2 Voyagers from V2 AI kept their cosmic theme going at the Manning Bar with a medley of Nicki Minaj's "Starships" and Sneaky Sound System's "UFO", silver spacesuits and all. Who knew "UFO" needed double kick? They took third place and best Crowd Vibe.

Video shot by @sailornicole and @demonrace. Photos and video sponsored by V2 AI.
